BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS( SELECT PO_NO FROM PO_KEPSUP WHERE PO_NO = RTRIM($LEGACY_PO_NO$) AND PO_LINE_NO = CAST(ISNULL($PO_LINE_NO$,0) AS FLOAT) AND PO_SHIPMENT_ID = CAST(ISNULL($PO_SHIPMENT_ID$,0) AS FLOAT) ) BEGIN INSERT INTO PO_KEPSUP( PO_NO, PO_LINE_NO, PO_SHIPMENT_ID, SUPPLIER_NAME, SUPPLIER_PERSON_NAME, SUPPLIER_TELNO, SHIP_DATE )VALUES( RTRIM($LEGACY_PO_NO$), CAST(ISNULL($PO_LINE_NO$,0) AS FLOAT), CAST(ISNULL($PO_SHIPMENT_ID$,0) AS FLOAT), ISNULL(SUBSTRING(RTRIM($SELLER_NAME$),1,20),' '), ISNULL(SUBSTRING(RTRIM($SELLER_PERSON_NAME$),1,10),' '), ISNULL(SUBSTRING(RTRIM($SELLER_TELNO$),1,15),' '), CASE $DS_DATE$ WHEN 'X' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM($DS_DATE$) END ) END
ELSE BEGIN UPDATE PO_KEPSUP SET SUPPLIER_NAME = ISNULL(SUBSTRING(RTRIM($SELLER_NAME$),1,20),' '), SUPPLIER_PERSON_NAME = ISNULL(SUBSTRING(RTRIM($CTDT.SELLER_PERSON_NAME$),1,10),' '), SUPPLIER_TELNO = ISNULL(SUBSTRING(RTRIM($CTDT.SELLER_TELNO$),1,15),' '), SHIP_DATE = CASE $DS_DATE$ WHEN 'X' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM($DS_DATE$) END WHERE PO_NO = RTRIM($LEGACY_PO_NO$) AND PO_LINE_NO = CAST(ISNULL($PO_LINE_NO$,0) AS FLOAT) AND PO_SHIPMENT_ID = CAST(ISNULL($PO_SHIPMENT_ID$,0) AS FLOAT) END END
